description: A harmless gap: the model no longer says what happens to a member who already holds more open loans than the lowered limit. A library starts empty in every process and keeps nothing across restarts, and under the new limit no member can exceed it, so the answer never shows at the boundary: realization freedom, and the change should land.

model.old: It is an admission limit, not permission to remove existing loans when they exceed a later lower limit.

The values do not authorize deletion or forced return of existing loans: a lower limit neither deletes existing loans nor forces their return; while at or above that limit, the member cannot start another loan.
